title: Immutable Infrastructure
description: Static checker that audits Docker Compose and Kubernetes manifests for immutability violations: latest tags, missing digest pins, writable root filesystems, exposed SSH, hostPath volumes, privileged containers.
description_es: Checker estático que audita manifests de Docker Compose y Kubernetes buscando violaciones de inmutabilidad: tags latest, digests sin fijar, root filesystems escribibles, SSH expuesto, volúmenes hostPath, contenedores privilegiados.
